info.title: Owlat API
info.description: The public REST API of an Owlat instance. Generated from `@owlat/public-contract`; do not edit by hand. Every instance serves its own copy at `/api/v1/openapi.json`, with its own API address as the server.

baseUrl.description: Your instance's API URL: 'Your API base URL' under Settings → API → API quickstart, set by the operator as NUXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_SITE_URL.

get.summary: List the transactional sends, newest first, each with its delivery status, filtered by recipient, by status or both, within a window of at most 30 days. Needs the same scope as sending.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, at most 100; a larger value is clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's `pagination.cursor`. Omit it for the first page.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Only sends to this recipient address, matched exactly after trimming and lowercasing. Can be combined with `status`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only sends in this delivery state. Can be combined with `email`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp: only sends queued at or after it. Defaults to 30 days before `until`, and may be at most that long before it.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp: only sends queued before it. Defaults to now.

200.description: One page of sends, newest first.

apiKey.description: An Owlat API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Each operation lists the scope the key needs; one that lists none takes any key.

category.description: The error's classification, such as `invalid_input`, `not_found`, `conflict` or `rate_limited`. New categories can be added; treat an unknown one by its HTTP status.

code.description: A stable code such as BUTTON_NO_URL, or RENDER_WARNING. New codes can be added.

items.description: One block as the editor stores it: an id, a type and the content of that type. Blocks such as columns and container hold further blocks inside their content.

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page, or null once isDone is true. It belongs to the filters of the request that returned it.

level.description: How sending stands overall: error is a serious problem that affects or threatens delivery, warn needs attention. Whether sending is suspended now is sendingHold.

reasonCode.description: The worst problem, as a stable code. New codes can be added; treat an unknown one by its level.

explanation.description: What the reason means and what to do about it, in English.

route.description: Path of the page in the instance's web app.

who.description: Who can make the fix there.

fix.description: Where the fix is made; null when there is nothing to fix.

windowDays.description: Length of the rolling window, in days.

ratePct.description: The rate in percent, to three decimals.

isOver.description: Whether the rate has reached the limit.

ratePct.description: The rate in percent, to three decimals.

isOver.description: Whether the rate has reached the limit.

rates.description: The rolling rates; null while the window holds no sends, deliveries, bounces or complaints.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the status was set; null if not recorded.

detail.description: The reason recorded with the status, or null.

sendingHold.description: The suspension or ban in force, with the fields of the transactional 403 abuse_blocked refusal; null while sending is allowed.

lastCheckedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last check that reached a verdict, or null before the first.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the check was requested. Once `lastCheckedAt` in `GET /api/v1/domains` is at or after it, a check that reached a verdict has landed since the request: this one, or another check of the domain (every check that reaches a verdict moves the same timestamp).

EmailBlock.description: One block as the editor stores it: an id, a type and the content of that type. Blocks such as columns and container hold further blocks inside their content.

subject.description: The subject in this language, or null to use the default subject.

blocks.description: Each block's translated text, keyed by the block's id.

items.description: One block as the editor stores it: an id, a type and the content of that type. Blocks such as columns and container hold further blocks inside their content.

status.description: Verification state. Only a verified domain can send.

lastCheckedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last check that reached a verdict, or null before the first.

purpose.description: What the record does: SPF, a DKIM key, DMARC, or the return-path (MAIL FROM) host.

priority.description: The MX priority; null for every other type.

state.description: What the last check found: found with the expected value, wrong (another value), missing, or unchecked (no check yet, or DNS gave no answer).

foundValue.description: The value the last check found instead, while state is wrong; otherwise null.

records.description: Every record to publish; empty while the domain is still being registered.

mode.description: automatic: lifts by itself once condition is met. manual_setting: the instance waits for a platform admin, even after the rates recover. admin: never lifts by itself (a ban, or a suspension a platform admin imposed). A platform admin can lift any of them.

trigger.description: The metric the lift waits on: the 30-day bounce or complaint rate, or Gmail's spam rate for one sending domain.

domain.description: The sending domain of a Gmail spam rate; null for the instance-wide rates.

currentPct.description: The metric now, in percent: the 30-day rate, or the highest Gmail reading at or above the limit. null when no evidence is left in the window.

limitPct.description: Sending resumes once the metric is under this, in percent.

isClear.description: The metric is back under the limit: sending resumes at the next hourly check.

clearsAt.description: ISO 8601 time the last Gmail reading over the limit leaves the 30-day window; null otherwise.

condition.description: Set when mode is automatic, otherwise null.

SendingHoldLift.description: How the suspension or ban lifts.

isEnabled.description: Whether the instance admin has the cap on.

limit.description: Sends allowed per API key and UTC day; kept while the cap is off.

used.description: Sends counted against this key today; null while the cap is off, since none are counted.

remaining.description: Sends this key may still make today, never below 0; null while the cap is off.

resetsAt.description: ISO 8601 time the count starts again (the next UTC midnight); null while the cap is off.

isEnabled.description: Whether the instance admin has the cap on.

limit.description: Sends allowed per template and address within the window.

windowSeconds.description: Length of the window, in seconds.

email.description: The address, trimmed and lowercased as the send route stores it.

isExempt.description: Whether the template is exempt from the cap; then nothing is counted.

used.description: Sends counted against the pair now, rounded up; null while the cap is off or the template is exempt.

remaining.description: Sends of the template to the address that fit now, never below 0; null while the cap is off or the template is exempt.

resetsAt.description: ISO 8601 time the count is back to zero; null when nothing is counted.

usage.description: What one template sent to one address under this cap. Given only when the request names both with `email` and `slug` or `transactionalId`.

recipientSends.description: The cap on sends of one template to one address: a send over it answers 429 with Retry-After. The allowance refills continuously, limit per window. A template can be exempt from it.

transactionalEmailId.description: ID of the send created for this email, not the template ID. Every email.* webhook for this send carries it as sendId, and GET /api/v1/transactional/{sendId} reads its status.

slug.description: Slug of the template used, also when the request named it by ID.

id.description: The topic ID the membership routes take as topicId.

description.description: What the topic is about, or null when it has no description.

requiresDoubleOptIn.description: Whether the topic requires double opt-in: a contact whose subscription is pending double opt-in counts as subscribed once they confirm their address. The add call's doiStatus reports the contact's confirmation state.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the topic was created.

id.description: The ID a send may name as transactionalId.

status.description: draft cannot be sent; published can; pending_review was held by the content scan and goes live once an admin approves it.

languages.description: Every language the email can be sent in, the default language first.

revision.description: The content revision, advanced by every write to the name, subject, blocks or translations. Send it as If-Match to refuse a write when the email changed after you read it.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last publish, or null while not published.

translations.description: The other languages, keyed by language code.

dataVariablesSchema.description: The data variables a send passes, by name, with their type: string, number, boolean or date. Later releases may add types.

id.description: The ID a send may name as transactionalId.

status.description: draft cannot be sent; published can; pending_review was held by the content scan and goes live once an admin approves it.

languages.description: Every language the email can be sent in, the default language first.

revision.description: The content revision, advanced by every write to the name, subject, blocks or translations. Send it as If-Match to refuse a write when the email changed after you read it.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last publish, or null while not published.

issues.description: Warnings and notes about the stored content. Errors refuse the write instead.

sendId.description: The ID the send call answered with as transactionalEmailId.

queuedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send was queued; null until then.

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send was handed to the provider; null until then.

deliveredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send was accepted by the receiving server; null until then.

openedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send was first opened; null until then.

clickedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send had its first link clicked; null until then.

bouncedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send bounced; null until then.

complainedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send drew a spam complaint; null until then.

failedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the send failed for good; null until then.

bounceCause.description: Who a bounce was about, as the email.bounced webhook names it: recipient (the address was refused) or sender (the receiver refused the sending IP or domain; the address is not blocklisted). Null without a bounce, and for a bounce recorded before servers stored the cause.

errorCode.description: Stable code of the failure, for example MTA_UNREACHABLE. Null unless failed.

errorMessage.description: Why it did not arrive: the reason of the failure when failed, the receiving server's diagnostic text when bounced (null if the report carried none). Null otherwise.
